How to reduce clinic no-shows

Published 20 October 2026 by Mohsin Khan.

No-shows are one of the most expensive problems a small clinic faces. Every empty slot is lost revenue and a patient who did not get care. The good news is that most no-shows are preventable with simple, consistent habits. Below are seven tactics that work for small hospitals, ordered from the cheapest to the most involved, with notes on what each one costs to run and how to measure whether it is working for your clinic.

1. Send reminders on the channel patients read

In India that usually means WhatsApp rather than SMS or email. Send one reminder the day before and one two hours before.
